This proposition records Segall's summary that German Jews supplied their
proportional share of military participants. It is reviewed pilot-calibration
evidence for negative or qualifying use against allegations that German Jews
failed to contribute militarily.

[`propositions.jsonl`](https://github.com/ashitaka-emishi/fspp-research-wrokbench/blob/master/projects/sacrificial-debt/data/propositions.jsonl)

Segall's statistical summary qualifies later claims that German Jews failed to
provide proportional military contribution. A later non-dischargeability claim
would need separate actor-source evidence showing accusations persisted despite
available contribution evidence.
